items.source: A simple CacheResolver that resolves the Cache instance(s) based on a configurable CacheManager and the name of the cache(s) as provided by getCacheNames().
items.translation: 一个简单的CacheResolver，它根据可配置的CacheManager以及由getCacheNames()提供的缓存名称，解析Cache实例。

items.source: A simple CacheResolver that resolves the exception cache based on a configurable CacheManager and the name of the cache: CacheResultOperation.getExceptionCacheName().
items.translation: 一个简单的 `CacheResolver`，它根据可配置的 `CacheManager` 和缓存名称（即：CacheResultOperation.getExceptionCacheName()）解析异常缓存。

items.source: A CacheResolver that forces the resolution to a configurable collection of name(s) against a given CacheManager.
items.translation: 一个 `CacheResolver`，强制将解析结果映射到给定 CacheManager 的可配置名称集合。

items.source: Uses of AbstractCacheResolver in org.springframework.cache.interceptor
Uses of AbstractCacheResolver in org.springframework.cache.jcache.interceptor
items.translation: `org.springframework.cache.jcache.interceptor` 包中 `AbstractCacheResolver` 的用法

items.source: AOP-based solution for declarative caching demarcation.
items.translation: 基于 AOP 的声明式缓存分界解决方案。

items.source: AOP-based solution for declarative caching demarcation using JSR-107 annotations.
items.translation: 使用 JSR-107 注解进行声明式缓存划分的基于 AOP 的解决方案。
